```{dot}
//| label: fig-Trees_Simple
//| fig-cap: A simple decision tree for predicting house prices. The root node splits on living area, and the terminal nodes represent predicted prices.
//| fig-height: 3
digraph DecisionTree {
  rankdir = TB
  nodesep = 1.2
  ranksep = 1.0
  bgcolor = "transparent"
  node [fontname = "Helvetica", fontsize = 12, penwidth = 1.8]
  edge [penwidth = 1.4, fontname = "Helvetica", fontsize = 10]

  // Root node (decision)
  Root [
    label = <<TABLE BORDER="0" CELLBORDER="0" CELLSPACING="2">
      <TR><TD><B>Living Area</B></TD></TR>
      <TR><TD>&gt; 150 m²?</TD></TR>
    </TABLE>>
    shape = diamond
    width = 2.2
    height = 1.4
    style = "filled,rounded"
    fillcolor = "#DCEEFB"
    color = "#2B7BB9"
  ]

  // Leaf nodes (predictions)
  Left [
    label = <<TABLE BORDER="0" CELLBORDER="0" CELLSPACING="2">
      <TR><TD><B>1.4M DKK</B></TD></TR>
      <TR><TD><FONT POINT-SIZE="9" COLOR="#555555">Small house</FONT></TD></TR>
    </TABLE>>
    shape = box
    style = "filled,rounded"
    fillcolor = "#E3F2E1"
    color = "#3A8A3A"
    width = 1.6
  ]

  Right [
    label = <<TABLE BORDER="0" CELLBORDER="0" CELLSPACING="2">
      <TR><TD><B>2.4M DKK</B></TD></TR>
      <TR><TD><FONT POINT-SIZE="9" COLOR="#555555">Large house</FONT></TD></TR>
    </TABLE>>
    shape = box
    style = "filled,rounded"
    fillcolor = "#E3F2E1"
    color = "#3A8A3A"
    width = 1.6
  ]

  // Edges with styled labels
  Root -> Left  [label = <<FONT COLOR="#C0392B">No</FONT>>, color = "#C0392B"]
  Root -> Right [label = <<FONT COLOR="#27AE60">Yes</FONT>>, color = "#27AE60"]
}
```
